verdict.rationale: Missive's docs publish an llms.txt index at https://missiveapp.com/docs/llms.txt, and every docs page serves raw Markdown when .md is appended, which gives agents a documented, machine-readable entry point. The probes returning 404 at the root /llms.txt and /docs.md checked different paths, so they don't contradict this; they only show the index isn't at the conventional root location. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the site root for discoverability, independent or hands-on confirmation that /docs/llms.txt resolves, and an OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404) for agent-consumable API docs.
